verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML compliance platform, so suspicious-activity reporting is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows case management, case decisions, case audit trails and date-range data exports, but nothing about generating or preparing a suspicious-activity report, let alone a jurisdiction-specific one. Case exports and audit logs are adjacent building blocks, not the SAR-preparation capability itself.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can prepare a jurisdiction-specific suspicious-activity report from case evidence
